notes.title: Lift Your Spirits
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198248/16ca1f8e60647502721912c65b84e639120b44b1.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

A couple of months have passed since we released the demo for Soul Mates, and if you’ve been itching for more, this update is for you! Read on for a little sneak peek at what we’ve accomplished since we last spoke. [b]Note[/b]: These are updates for the main game and not the demo build.

First up, we added an overworld! Your new favorite haunted house now has a foyer, and that foyer has some very cool (and somewhat spine-chilling) features. We’re going to keep those a secret for now, though. Mwahaha!

Moving on, we’ve also fleshed out Mary’s level, which means the whole process of wooing her involves more puzzles and even more conversation than before. The next two levels are also under construction, each with its own unique ghost girl and lots of new handcrafted art in progress!

One thing to keep in mind is that there are only a small handful of Pandas working on Soul Mates, and that’s on top of the usual work of creating and implementing new content for our other games, Crush Crush and Blush Blush. Having that many irons in the fire means progress might be a little on the slow side, but we promise we’re working away! We’re aiming to have an early version of Soul Mates ready to release in time for Halloween this year.

We hope this update soothes your troubled soul, and we want to say thank you, again, for wishlisting the game, sharing it with your friends, sharing it with your enemies, etc. Please stay tuned for further updates, and remember…

We truly love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: Ghouls Just Want To Have Fun
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198248/16ca1f8e60647502721912c65b84e639120b44b1.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

Now that Next Fest is over, we wanted to say a big THANK YOU to everyone who played the Soul Mates demo, wishlisted it, and most importantly, left feedback for us! We appreciate your support and your input more than you know.

We’ll be incorporating lots of your feedback into the demo as we work to polish it, and we’re taking all your comments into account as we flesh out the rest of the game. We’re currently working on stories, dialogue, and puzzle designs for several more spooky ghost gals, which also means we’re expanding the map to accommodate them all! Suffice to say, we’ve got some reeeally fun features planned for our haunted house.

Keep an eye out for updates, because they’re coming! And thank you again for all the love on this demo.

We truly love you so hard!

The Pandas
